note: Rules tracked by core.paper_runner. start = first month-end decision of the forward record. allocation_pct is the share of account equity placed when run with --execute; 0 means shadow only (nothing is ever sent). The decile rule is set to 50 (half size) as of 2026-10-14; the quintile rule stays shadow-only. Runs only place orders when started with --execute. Entries with kind "signal" are single-symbol rules run by core.signal_tracker; they are shadow-only and never place orders. They count only signals that fire at a close on or after start. Entries with kind "snapshot" (round 9) are 15:45-signal stock rules run by core.snapshot_tracker every 2nd or 3rd session (the rule's hold) from start; shadow-only, never place orders.
